name: Cut-out
summary: Lifts the main subject of a picture onto a transparent background, and makes a clean plate of a picture (its words, buttons and cards erased and filled), for copying a design into a page.
license: MIT (BiRefNet model, MI-GAN model, onnxruntime, pngjs, Node.js); Apache-2.0 (LaMa model, PP-OCRv5 text detection)

upstream.model: BiRefNet general lite (bb_swin_v1_tiny, epoch 232), the ONNX export rembg publishes
upstream.lamaModel: big-lama (advimman/lama), the ONNX port by Carve (Carve/LaMa-ONNX lama_fp32.onnx, 512 x 512)
upstream.ocrDetModel: PP-OCRv5 server text detection (PaddleOCR), ONNX export from monkt/paddleocr-onnx detection/v5
upstream.miganModel: MI-GAN 512 pipeline (Picsart AI Research, MIT code and MIT weights), ONNX from huggingface.co/andraniksargsyan/migan
upstream.uiElementsModel: RF-DETR medium fine-tuned on mobile UI designs (merve/rf-detr-mobile-ui, Apache-2.0), exported to ONNX by tools/export_ui_elements.py (tools/make_ui_elements.sh: pinned source, pinned environment, the same bytes wherever it runs); build.sh takes it from dist/models
